items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because I had a chance to see, as a teenager I had a chance to see and hear the Jimmy Lunceford band, man.

ctx.x: Because I had a chance to see, as a teenager I had a chance to see and hear the Jimmy Lunceford band, man. I'll tell you something, man. I ain't never heard anything like that in my life. And I ain't never saw a group of men carry themselves...I think I talked....

items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was fascinated about, Jimmie Lunceford's band.

ctx.x: You know, they would always--but I was--I was fascinated about, Jimmie Lunceford's band. For some reason, they kept me--and every one of those guys was gentlemans, man. They would step off the bus like they just came from downtown somewhere. They all had suits on, you know.
